items.headline: Google launches Gemini 3 Pro
items.summary: Google calls Gemini 3 Pro its most intelligent model and reports 1501 Elo on LMArena, 37.5% on Humanity's Last Exam without tools and 76.2% on SWE-bench Verified. It launched in preview in the Gemini app, Search AI Mode, the Gemini API and the new Google Antigravity platform.
